events.title: Canadian Market Headed For Weak Close
events.description: he Canadian market is down firmly in negative territory Tuesday afternoon, weighed down by rising bond yields and worries about inflation amid elevated oil prices. The Fed is widely expected to raise interest rate by 25 basis points. The post-meeting comments are eyed for clues about the central bank's future rate path.

events.title: Swiss Market Ends Moderately Lower
events.description: The Switzerland stock market ended weak on Tuesday as worries about geopolitical tensions, rising bond yields and elevated oil prices rendered the mood cautious.

events.title: European Stocks Close Weak
events.description: European stock markets ended lower on Tuesday as investors awaited monetary policy decisions from the Federal Reserve, Bank of England, and Bank of Japan. Rising bond yields, elevated oil prices following Saudi pipeline closures, and mixed economic data across the region weighed on sentiment.

events.title: New York Manufacturing Index Pulls Back Sharply But Remains Positive
events.description: The Federal Reserve Bank of New York released a report on Tuesday showing its reading on regional manufacturing activity fell by much more than expected in the month of September but still indicated growth. The New York Fed said its general business conditions index slumped to 7.6 in September from 20.6 in August.

events.title: New York Manufacturing Index Slumps Much More Than Expected In September
events.description: The Federal Reserve Bank of New York released a report on Tuesday showing its reading on regional manufacturing activity fell by much more than expected in the month of September but still indicated growth.

events.title: Bay Street Likely To Open On Slightly Weak Note
events.description: Weak Canadian and U.S. futures, lower precious metals prices and concerns about inflation and interest rates could weigh on Canadian stocks Tuesday morning. Investors look ahead to Federal Reserve's monetary policy announcement on Wednesday.

events.title: Yen Falls Against Majors
events.description: The Japanese yen weakened against other major currencies in the European session on Tuesday.

events.title: FTSE 100 Recovers Despite Weak UK Jobs Data, Oil Concerns
events.description: The FTSE 100 recovered from early losses on Tuesday as consumer and real estate stocks rallied. Disappointing employment data and oil price concerns pressured equities, while traders awaited policy guidance from global central banks.

events.title: Rising Oil Prices, Inflation Push CAC 40 To 4-Month Trough
events.description: France's annual inflation rate climbed to 2.4% in August from 2.1% in July, marking the highest reading in three months. The CAC 40 slid to a four-month low amid rising oil prices and elevated bond yields.

events.title: German ZEW Economic Sentiment Improves Moderately
events.description: German economic confidence improved moderately in September as experts were cautiously optimistic about economic recovery, survey results from the Mannheim-based Centre for European Economic Research, or ZEW, showed Tuesday. The ZEW indicator of economic sentiment rose less-than-expected to 34.7 in September from 34.2 in the previous month. The reading was seen at 39.8.

events.title: Indian Shares Tumble On Rising Oil Prices, Bond Yields
events.description: Indian shares fell sharply on Tuesday as trading resumed after a long holiday weekend.

events.title: German Stocks Dip On Oil Spike And Rising Geopolitical Tensions
events.description: The DAX slipped 44.44 points Tuesday amid higher oil prices and bond yields driven by geopolitical concerns. Brent crude jumped nearly 2.5% after Saudi Arabia closed a key pipeline. Germany's August wholesale prices rose 6.8% year-on-year, accelerating from 5.3% previously.

events.title: China Industrial Output Strengthens; Retail Sales Miss Forecast
events.description: China's industrial production growth accelerated in August on robust foreign demand, while retail sales logged a weaker growth and fixed asset investment downturn worsened further, underscoring the challenges in achieving the official growth target this year.
